newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends weaker at 3,355/65 vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends weaker at 3,355/65 vs dlr.

text.p: 1510 GMT - The Romanian leu closed lower on Friday at 3,355/65 to the dollar against 3,335/45 in early trading on a quiet interbank market hit by chronical hard currency squeezes.
* The leu's interbank rate weakened by some 1.5 percent from last Friday but its street prices plunged to a leu-dollar low of around 4,000/4,300, from around 3,650 last week.
* Operators said interbank trading remained lethargic while most intrabank deals focused on other currencies whose cross rates yield weaker leu-dollar rates of about 3,700-3,800.
* Latest central bank data showed a $179,800 interbank volume on Friday, when overall trading was $12.4 million.
* Short-term money market rates stayed near 42 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
